data_description.fp2_room: Occupancy sensor of the FP2 zone covering the whole room (not the bathroom).
data_description.door_witnesses: Sensors that see the door: the FP2 door zone and/or a motion sensor aimed at it. Leaving needs one of them.
data_description.phone_tracker: Device tracker of the occupant's phone (its zone).
data_description.phone_ssid: Sensor with the Wi-Fi network the phone is on (optional).

error.door_witness_required: Pick at least one door sensor.

abort.already_configured: This FP2 room zone is already tracked.

data_description.crossing_window: How far back from the FP2 going empty a door-sensor trigger counts as walking out (seconds).
data_description.bathroom_window: After a crossing, a bathroom-sensor trigger within this time means the bathroom, not leaving (seconds).
data_description.recently_left_duration: How long recently_left lasts before the place layer takes over (seconds).
data_description.sleep_quiet: In bed with no movement-sensor trigger for this long means sleeping (seconds).
data_description.wake_on_time: A movement-sensor trigger longer than this wakes (seconds).
data_description.bed_leave_grace: Leaving the bed zone for longer than this wakes (seconds).
data_description.exit_pre_window: FP2 unavailable: an exit needs motion this soon before the door trigger (seconds).
data_description.exit_quiet: FP2 unavailable: no motion for this long after the door means left (seconds).
data_description.exit_door_on_time: FP2 unavailable: the door trigger must last at least this long (seconds).
data_description.entry_window: FP2 unavailable: other sensors must trigger this soon after the door to count as an entry (seconds).
data_description.rebuild_lookback: Hours of recorder history replayed to rebuild the state.
data_description.entry_needs_crossing: Only count the FP2 room zone as an entry if a door sensor triggered just before.
data_description.movement: Motion sensor watching the bed; used to tell sleeping from lying awake.
data_description.fallback_motion: Motion sensors used while the FP2 is unavailable.
data_description.sleep_entities: When all of these turn off while in bed, that means sleeping (e.g. lights).

data_description.ssids: The phone on any of these networks is here.
data_description.zones: The phone tracker in any of these zones is here.
data_description.mode: any: an SSID or a zone is enough; all: needs both.
data_description.priority: Lower wins when several places match.
data_description.on_site: Counts as home (e.g. the building's common room) and never overrides the room sensors.

error.place_name_reserved: That name is a built-in location; pick another.
error.place_name_taken: Another place already has that name.
error.place_needs_ssid_or_zone: Give at least one Wi-Fi network or zone.

entry_not_found.message: No loaded room_presence entry has the id {entry_id}.

entry_required.message: Several room_presence entries are loaded: give config_entry_id.

invalid_state.message: {state} is not a location you can set: use bed, desk, room, bathroom, sleeping, recently_left, away or a configured place.

set_state.name: Set state
set_state.description: Correct the tracked location, now or after a delay. Inference continues from the new state.

config_entry_id.name: Room
config_entry_id.description: The room_presence entry to correct. Needed only when there are several.

state.name: State
state.description: bed, desk, room, bathroom, sleeping, recently_left, away, or a place slug.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds to wait before applying. A new call cancels a pending one; a pending call does not survive a restart.
